lead.t: Internal carotid artery (ICA): Proximal source of emboli; carotid stenosis is a major preventable cause.

snip.t: Internal carotid artery (ICA): Proximal source of emboli; carotid stenosis is a major preventable cause.

Sites of rupture: internal carotid artery, including the posterior communicating junction (about 41%); anterior communicating artery or anterior cerebral artery (about 34%); middle cerebral artery (about 20%); vertebrobasilar system (about 4%).
Posterior communicating or internal carotid artery aneurysm: a third (oculomotor) nerve palsy (ptosis, dilated pupil, "down and out" eye) with retro-orbital pain.
The internal carotid artery has only 1 branch in the neck d.
